scene: Yanking the giant radish reveals a hidden trapdoor underneath!
picture: Flat side view. On the far left stands a tall bamboo trellis. The player stands centre-left holding her red umbrella and looking right. In the centre lies the freshly pulled giant purple radish. On the right, revealed in the raised soil bed, sits a shut round metal trapdoor with a brass ring handle.
shown: A round metal trapdoor lying flat in the soil on the right.
A tall bamboo trellis leaning on the far left against the wall.
The freshly uprooted giant purple radish lying in the centre.

variants.scene: The enormous radish pops out, uncovering a mysterious round metal door.
Fresh dirt flies as the massive vegetable uncovers an old iron hatch.
Sweet honey scents the rooftop breeze after pulling up the huge radish.
